title: Mill Creek Business Park LOI from Demo Flex Owners LLC
summary: Demo Flex Owners LLC offers $15,300,000 for Mill Creek Business Park with a $300,000 deposit and 30-day due diligence.

evidence.quote: This letter of intent is dated November 18, 2026.
The Buyer is Demo Flex Owners LLC.

fields.value: Model Fund I — Mill Creek LLC

evidence.quote: The Seller is Model Fund I — Mill Creek LLC.
Buyer will deliver an initial deposit of $300,000 within three business days of a signed purchase agreement.
Buyer shall have a due diligence period of 30 days.
Closing will occur 45 days after the end of the due diligence period.

fields.value: Buyer's obligations are not contingent on financing.

evidence.quote: Buyer's obligations are not contingent on financing.
